description.en: A Storage settings page for DeepSeek Harness: a donut of what dsh occupies on this machine (install, sessions, attachments, runtimes, plugins, temp), a drill-down that lists archived sessions and can delete them (to the system Recycle Bin), and a clean action that only touches rebuildable caches. Windows-only for the system Recycle Bin and Open folder; scanning works everywhere.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「存储空间」设置页：环形图展示本机 dsh 占用（程序本体、会话、附件、运行时、插件、临时目录），可按工作区/类型下钻、列出已归档会话并删除（进系统回收站），清理只动可再生缓存。（系统回收站与打开目录仅 Windows，扫描与统计跨平台可用。）
